note: The intermediate payload the core CLI extracts before materializing a customer project. Deliberately narrower than the public source repository: it carries the application, reusable test inputs, brand configuration and materializer closure, not the repository's governance, design inventory or release workflows. The materializer is the single owner of the final generated-project file selection.

rationale.src/: The application and its reusable tests. The materializer removes repository-only evidence tests when creating the customer project; keeping that decision in one owner prevents local and released generation from drifting.
rationale.assets/images/: App icons and splash imagery. Every file passes the ownership ledger before a release is published.
rationale.assets/figma/brand-mark.svg: The default manifest's brand mark; custom manifests can replace it from their validated asset root.
rationale.template/: The canonical brand manifest, fixtures and release policy consumed by the materializer.
rationale.scripts/materialize-mobile-template.mjs: The core CLI invokes this intermediate runner directly. Its transitive imports and every root file it copies into the generated project are included; it rewrites package.json and package-lock.json before the customer project is exposed.
